system.description:
Your [Recovery] increases by +6. [Trigger: Text] Used when you give yourself a [Barrier]. The strength of the [Barrier] increases by +30. Once per scene. The sword said to have been wielded by the warrior priestesses who fought in secret to eradicate evil from the world. By striking it with prayer, cherry blossom snow flurries dance from the blade's surface, protecting the wielder.

Dragon Eye Stone [Core Material] (240G) + Military Saber (380G) + White Hitokata (Intermediate) (230G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 12] (150G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (640G)
